labels.look: White, a full page of serif text drawn as grey outlines with blue on-curve and orange off-curve points, sidebearing boxes, floating control panel
labels.ux: Whole text is editable; weight, width and point-size sliders; colour pickers for outline, points, fill and background
labels.learn: Ship a colour-font 'x-ray' version so anyone can see Bézier points, spacing and kerning by just typing

labels.variantDefinition: Slim header: the family name as logo, a one-line tagline and section tabs; stands in for a hero
labels.look: Pale mint, bold green slab 'INPUT™', mono tagline, tabs Intro / Preview / Info / Download, small logo glyphs right
labels.ux: Tabs switch or jump between the site's sections
labels.learn: For a tool-like font, a compact masthead with tabs gets visitors to the preview faster than a splash

labels.look: White, black 'Introducing…' ribbon, large name (rendered in a fallback serif: webfont not loaded), short paragraph, 'Just $30' starburst and yellow BUY NOW
labels.learn: A price starburst next to the buy button answers 'how much?' before the visitor has to ask

labels.look: Black, right-aligned white paragraph that shifts from sans to serif lower down, slim sticky 'GT Ultra / Try / Buy' bar
labels.ux: Contrast axis (CNTR) animates the paragraph between sans and serif, likely on scroll
labels.learn: When the pitch is 'between sans and serif', let the pitch sentence itself travel along that axis

labels.look: Flat illustration of a purple-and-white cargo jet with yellow 'Halyard Display' on the fuselage, airport signs; black band below with Micro/Text/Display weight rows; cookie notice at corner
labels.ux: Title on the plane is editable; weight lists scroll as marquees
labels.learn: Paint the editable title onto an object in the scene (a plane livery) so testing feels like branding

labels.variantDefinition: States the problem the typeface solves: purpose, intended readers, constraints and principles, as a numbered list or spec rather than an origin narrative
labels.look: Pink, large italic pull quote left, numbered principles and references right, monospace 'SHORT BRIEF' card; sticky nav overlaps
labels.ux: static; sticky nav with download, PDF and GitHub links
labels.learn: Publish the brief as a spec (users, readers, purpose, compatibility) so a functional font is judged by its goals

labels.variantDefinition: A playable browser game made with the font, with a high-score leaderboard and font licences as prizes
labels.look: Three bright panels: red leaderboard with scores, coral game canvas 'Click to Start' in green, yellow speech-bubble rules
labels.ux: Keyboard platform game (left, right, space); submit name and email to save a high score
labels.learn: Turn the launch into a competition: top scores win the family, and players read the font for minutes

labels.look: White, plain sans intro with yellow play button video, then pale-blue rules; bad cut merges intro, mission, feature cards (B8 O0, 1Il) and family versions
labels.ux: Video, Download Now and Learn More buttons; otherwise static
labels.learn: Open with 'Is this font easy for you to read? Good—that's the idea': the reader tests the claim on that line

labels.variantDefinition: A short 'about' paragraph (designers, character, family size) set large in the font, so the description doubles as a text-size specimen, often with a 'more' link
labels.look: Charcoal, large light-grey geometric sans paragraph; sticky bar with theme options; cookie notice across the top
labels.ux: 'More information' expands the history; bar switches Black site / White site / Color
labels.learn: Let visitors flip the whole site dark, light or colour: the same text shows how the font holds up on each
